I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own message in the channel on June 9 at 10:48 AM. The morning receiver there said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login. Nothing later in the channel says whether that was fixed, and I told her so.

I only read #central-team and a public team file, and she's a member of that channel. I didn't use message search. Nothing in the answer is a finance figure.
